Does JCPenney sell luggage?

What size is carry on luggage?

Carry-on luggage is typically sized to meet airline guidelines for overhead bin storage. Most airlines allow carry-on pieces no larger than about 22 inches tall, 14 inches wide, and 9 inches deep, but you should check with your specific airline, as requirements can vary by carrier and aircraft type. You can find carry-on luggage that meets these dimensions at JCPenney.com.

Where can you buy packing cubes?
